scheme_name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
other_conditions: Self Help Groups (SHGs) must have been active for at least the last 6 months as per their books of account.
SHGs must practice the ‘Panchasutras’: regular meetings, regular savings, regular inter‑loaning, timely repayment, and maintain up‑to‑date books of accounts.
SHGs must be qualified as per grading norms fixed by NABARD.
Defunct SHGs can be eligible if revived and remain active for a minimum of 3 months.
Grading of federated SHGs may be performed by the federations to support banks.
benefits_summary: Creates bank‑linked Self Help Groups for rural poor households, especially women, providing financial inclusion, livelihood support, and institutional capacity building.
